title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
contentSnippet: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

title: GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise
contentSnippet:
GitHub’s context-aware secret classifier improves detection quality, raises weighted acceptance by 11.5%, and reduces median scan execution time by 86%.
The post GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
